statements.text: Space is the four-dimensional hyperbolic honeycomb {3,4,3,4}, whose docks are 24-cells, with 24 slots per dock, one per direction. The package runs the knit on the flat D4 lattice and on small D4 boxes, which have the same 24 directions per dock, not on {3,4,3,4} itself.
